    // The two endpoint vertices of a half-edge in its own direction: A is the
    // Origin, B is the Destination. NOT canonically ordered (A.Value may exceed
    // B.Value); take the twin's endpoints for the reverse direction.
    DirectedEndpointsOf(self: IHalfEdge, halfEdge: HalfEdgeIndex): VertexPair
        => (self.OriginOf(halfEdge), self.DestinationOf(halfEdge));
